passage.text: Last Sunday, I decided not to buy anything new for one week.
passage.reading: ˈlæst ˈsʌndeɪ, aɪ dɪˈsaɪdɪd ˈnɑːt tə ˈbaɪ ˈɛniθɪŋ ˈnuː fər ˈwʌn ˈwiːk.

passage.text: I only wanted to buy food and things that I really needed.
passage.reading: aɪ ˈoʊnli ˈwɑːntɪd tə ˈbaɪ ˈfuːd ənd ˈθɪŋz ðæt aɪ ˈriːli ˈniːdɪd.

passage.text: Our generation consumes too much, and I wanted to see if I could stop.
passage.reading: aʊr ˌdʒɛnəˈreɪʃən kənˈsuːmz ˈtuː ˈmʌtʃ, ənd aɪ ˈwɑːntɪd tə ˈsiː ɪf aɪ kʊd ˈstɑːp.

passage.text: On Wednesday, I saw a flash sale for shoes, and I almost clicked "buy."
passage.reading: ɑːn ˈwɛnzdeɪ, aɪ ˈsɔː ə ˈflæʃ ˌseɪl fər ˈʃuːz, ənd aɪ ˈɔːlmoʊst ˈklɪkt ˈbaɪ.

passage.text: Then I asked myself, "Do I really need them?" The answer was no.
passage.reading: ˈðɛn aɪ ˈæskt maɪˈsɛlf, duː aɪ ˈriːli ˈniːd ˈðɛm? ði ˈænsər wʌz ˈnoʊ.

passage.text: On Thursday, I cleaned my room and found three T-shirts that I had never worn.
passage.reading: ɑːn ˈθɜːrzdeɪ, aɪ ˈkliːnd maɪ ˈruːm ənd ˈfaʊnd ˈθriː ˈtiːʃɜːrts ðæt aɪ hæd ˈnɛvər ˈwɔːrn.

passage.text: I felt embarrassed about all my unnecessary possessions.
passage.reading: aɪ ˈfɛlt ɪmˈbærəst əˈbaʊt ˈɔːl maɪ ʌnˈnɛsəsɛri pəˈzɛʃənz.

passage.text: On Friday, I gave some clothes to my cousin Bee and sold some old books online.
passage.reading: ɑːn ˈfraɪdeɪ, aɪ ˈɡeɪv sʌm ˈkloʊðz tə maɪ ˈkʌzən ˈbiː ənd ˈsoʊld sʌm ˈoʊld ˈbʊks ˌɑːnˈlaɪn.

passage.text: Now the week is over, and I didn't buy anything new!
passage.reading: ˈnaʊ ðə ˈwiːk ɪz ˈoʊvər, ənd aɪ ˈdɪdənt ˈbaɪ ˈɛniθɪŋ ˈnuː!

passage.text: I've saved almost two thousand baht, and my room looks much better.
passage.reading: aɪv ˈseɪvd ˈɔːlmoʊst ˈtuː ˈθaʊzənd ˈbɑːt, ənd maɪ ˈruːm ˈlʊks ˈmʌtʃ ˈbɛtər.

passage.text: I think I'll try it again next month.
passage.reading: aɪ ˈθɪŋk aɪl ˈtraɪ ɪt əˈɡɛn ˈnɛkst ˈmʌnθ.
